subject: Rename redis in install_server.sh file (#341)
reason: The change only edits utils/install_server.sh, an interactive root-only installer shell script that writes /etc/init.d services and system config files. It renames environment variables (REDIS_* to SERVER_*), default paths (/etc/redis to /etc/valkey), init-script names, and prompt text. No server code, tool binary, config option, protocol reply, replication, or persistence path is touched, so no fuzzer experiment can reach it: the fuzzer starts throwaway local servers and runs the built binaries, and this script is never executed by them (and would need root and system-wide installation if it
